title: Understanding Agglomerative Clustering
text: Agglomerative clustering is a type of hierarchical clustering that starts with each point as its own cluster and merges them step by step based on a linkage criterion.

title: Linkage Criteria
text: In average linkage clustering, the distance between two clusters is defined as the average distance between each point in one cluster and each point in the other cluster.

title: Effect of Random Tie-breaking
text: Since tie-breaking is done randomly, the clustering result can vary if there are ties in the distances between clusters.
